title: Swanada: Split-Encoder Capability-Routed Conformer CTC and Sub-30 MB On-Device Speech Recognition Across Twelve Scripts
abstract: arXiv:2611.13814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Client-side automatic speech recognition (ASR) across Indic and Classical scripts eliminates cloud transcription costs, network tail latency, and server-side audio retention, yet neural exports face four systems bottlenecks in browsers and mobile runtimes: (1) monolithic per-language Conformer checkpoints require ~177 MiB per script (> 2.1 GiB across 12 scripts), exhausting CacheStorage quotas; (2) static relative positional encoding tables embed 10.2-20.5 MB of FP32 constants while 1x1 Conv1d layers trigger slow or unsupported ConvInteger kernels in WebAssembly SIMD; (3) sliding-window CTC flickers on boundary tokens; and (4) mobile WebAudio pipelines suffer 44.1/48 kHz sample-rate mismatches and silent AudioWorklet stalls under iOS WKWebView.   We present Swanada, an open-source 16 kHz streaming ASR system spanning Classical Sanskrit, Indian English, and ten Indian languages (sa, en, hi, kn, mr, bn, ta, te, ml, gu, pa, or) across bro

translated_title: Swanada：分裂编码器能力路由的 Conformer CTC 与跨十二种文字的低于 30 MB 端侧语音识别
translated_abstract: 面向印度语系及古典文字的客户端自动语音识别（ASR）可以消除云端转写成本、网络尾延迟和服务器端音频留存问题，但神经模型在浏览器和移动运行时中导出时面临四个系统瓶颈：（1）单体式逐语言 Conformer 检查点每种文字需要约 177 MiB（12 种文字合计超过 2.1 GiB），会耗尽 CacheStorage 配额；（2）静态相对位置编码表嵌入 10.2-20.5 MB 的 FP32 常量，而 1x1 Conv1d 层在 WebAssembly SIMD 中会触发缓慢或不受支持的 ConvInteger 内核；（3）滑动窗口 CTC 在边界标记上出现闪烁；（4）移动端 WebAudio 管线存在 44.1/48 kHz 采样率不匹配问题，且在 iOS WKWebView 下 AudioWorklet 会出现静默卡顿。我们提出 Swanada，一个开源的 16 kHz 流式 ASR 系统，覆盖古典梵语、印度英语和十种印度语言（sa、en、hi、kn、mr、bn、ta、te、ml、gu、pa、or），跨越……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Swanada 提出了一种分裂编码器、能力路由的 Conformer CTC 架构，将覆盖十二种文字的开源流式端侧语音识别模型压缩到每个低于 30 MB，同时解决了浏览器与移动端部署中的存储配额、算子兼容、解码闪烁和音频管线四大系统瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Swanada presents an open-source split-encoder, capability-routed Conformer CTC architecture that compresses streaming on-device speech recognition across twelve scripts to sub-30 MB per model, resolving four systems bottlenecks—storage quotas, operator compatibility, decoding flicker, and WebAudio pipeline issues—for browser and mobile deployment.
